items.prompt: Which residual convention does this lesson use?

options.text: xhat-x, the usually unknown forward error
options.why: That is an answer difference rather than equation mismatch.
A scalar determinant is not a residual vector.
It can be calculated from the given system and candidate.

options.text: Axhat-b, without changing any later sign conventions
options.why: This is a legitimate alternative convention only if used consistently; this lesson explicitly uses the opposite residual sign.

items.explanation: The stated sign is b-Ax̂. A different sign has the same norm, but it must be used consistently in the algebra.
